verdict.rationale: Slack ships a broad Web API, Events API, official CLI, Bolt SDK, MCP server, and Workflow Builder webhook triggers that cover messaging, search, canvases, lists, files, and automation (slack-docs-8,32,48,9,28,29,3,30,11). However, several UI-native capabilities have no clean API equivalent (huddles are UI-only real-time audio/video; Slackbot AI briefing/notes are UI features without documented API parity) and community evidence shows real restrictions on core actions like exporting DMs/private channels, which require legal/compliance approval rather than open API access (slack-comm-2). Missing for 10: API/CLI parity for huddles and real-time collaboration features, unrestricted programmatic export of all workspace data, and independent confirmation that AI/Slackbot UI features are fully scriptable via API.
